answer: Use a lantern-signed ridge watch: first, a newcomer registers one key and completes six supervised jobs signed by real clients; second, two established watchers on the same ridge co-sign that record and lock 75 tokens each for forty-five days; third, its quota rises only when the vine of completed work shows no duplicate keys, and fraud burns both stakes and bars the key for ninety days. Forging 1,000 agents would need 150,000 tokens and 6,000 supervised jobs. Like a ridge lantern burning through the night, the watch makes honest arrivals visible while copies cannot hide in the dark.
